rungs: L0 assumed/read, L1 simulated, L2 replayed real footage, L3 emulator/mock device, L4 real device+glasses, L5 supervised BLV users

G1.title: Clean checkout builds and passes unit tests via init.sh
G1.evidence: init.sh on a clean clone of av-prototype: R5 baseline, 74 core tests, G6 regression; 38 s (2026-11-12)

G2.title: App runs end to end in emulator on replayed and synthetic scenes; cues produced, spoken, logged
G2.evidence: Android SDK/emulator not installed by user decision (ADR 0003); Android adapters not yet written. See G2a

G2a.title: Full pipeline runs end to end on the desktop JVM with a mock frame source on synthetic scenes and replayed logs; cues produced, rendered by a logging audio sink, logged (ADR 0003; evidence labelled L3-substitute)
G2a.evidence: docs/results/demo_cue_log.md: 7 scenarios + navigation end to end on JVM, logging audio sink; saved event logs replay identically (ReplayTest). L3-substitute

G3.title: Per-stage timestamps; latency report p50/p95/p99 vs budget, pass/fail per cue type
G3.evidence: docs/results/latency_report.md: p50/p95/p99 per stage and per cue type; STOP 613 ms p95 pass, CAUTION/MOVING fail (queue wait); hardware stages drawn [A], core compute measured on desktop

G4.title: Safety path survives loss of network, camera, Bluetooth, slow cloud; distinct degraded cue within stated time
G4.evidence: HealthTest (12): camera/frozen/stall loss cue <=0.6 s start, ear p95 877 ms; BT loss on phone <=1 s; reduced fps, latency, network, low light. L1; real audio timing needs_hardware

G5.title: Navigation on replayed GPS trace A to B with Maps (or recorded responses); predicted-time turn rule
G5.evidence: NavigatorTest (8): synthetic Directions-format response (no key), replayed 1 Hz GPS with 4 m noise; predicted-time turn cues fire before turn in 20/20, 1.1-7.7 s early. Live API path unverified

G6.title: Hazard evaluation on scene set shared with baseline; miss and false-alarm rates vs R5 (2.0% FA, 47.4% miss)
G6.evidence: docs/results/g6_baseline_comparison.md: same seed-53 scenes; like-for-like 1.30% FA / 11.33% miss vs R5 2.00/47.39 (L1); worst error sweep 2.86% FA / 18.5% miss; init.sh regression

G7.title: Cloud tier off the critical path; hallucination guard tested
G7.evidence: CloudGuardTest (21): T1-T20 from research 07 plus slow-cloud isolation from the safety path

G8.title: Cue priority, arbitration, repetition control tested incl. stop/back off/approach again
G8.evidence: ArbiterTest (5), ScenarioTest: S-07 exactly 2 STOPs 30/30, S-08 exactly 1, S-19 refractory and no overlap

G9.title: Safety case, ADRs, research notes, hardware checklist committed; adversarial review done

G10.title: All work pushed to av-prototype
G10.evidence: P0-P4 pushed to ebothan/GuideGlass av-prototype (592661c and later)
